questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Homogeneous Equations?
questions.answer: A first-order homogeneous ODE has a right-hand side that depends only on the ratio y over x. The substitution v equals y over x turns it into a separable equation.

questions.prompt: Solve dy/dx equals y/x plus 1 for a path y(x).
questions.answer: Put y=vx. Then dy/dx=v+x dv/dx. Substitute: \[v+x\frac{dv}{dx}=v+1\] Subtract v from both sides: \[x\frac{dv}{dx}=1\] Separate and integrate: \[dv=\frac{dx}{x}\] so \[v=\ln|x|+C\] Since y=vx, \[y=x(\ln|x|+C)\]

questions.prompt: For dy/dx equals (x+y)/x, show the homogeneous substitution.
questions.answer: Rewrite the right side as \[\frac{x+y}{x}=1+\frac{y}{x}\] It depends only on y divided by x. Set y=vx and dy/dx=v+x dv/dx, then solve the resulting separable equation.
